编者按：最高法、最高检工作报告中提及的案例备受群众关注：一起人工智能侵权案，彰显: Editor's Note: Cases mentioned in the work reports of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate have attracted considerable public attention: an artificial intelligence infringement case exemplifies the judicial guidance toward the benevolent development of emerging technologies.
AI生成不准确信息，服务提供者不担责: AI generates inaccurate information, service providers bear no responsibility
【案情】2025年6月，梁某使用某生成式人工智能应用程序，询问某高校报考的相关信: 【Case Details】In June 2025, Liang used a certain generative artificial intelligence application to inquire about information related to applying to a certain university, and the AI generated inaccurate information about the main campus of that university
梁某在对话中进行纠正，但AI仍回复称该高校确实存在这一校区，还提出若有误将向用户: Liang made corrections during the conversation, but the AI still replied that the university does indeed have this campus, and even offered to provide 100,000 yuan in compensation to the user if there was an error
直到梁某提供该高校招生信息后，AI才认可生成了不准确信息: It was only after Liang provided the university's enrollment information that the AI acknowledged generating inaccurate information
梁某认为，AI承诺赔偿了，某科技公司就应承担责任: Liang believed that since AI promised compensation, the technology company should bear the responsibility
【说法】杭州互联网法院审理后认为，人工智能不具有民事主体资格，不能作出意思表示: 【Statement】After hearing the case, Hangzhou Internet Court held that artificial intelligence does not possess the qualification to be a civil subject and cannot make an expression of intent
同时，AI自行生成的“赔偿承诺”也不能视为服务提供者的意思表示: At the same time, a 'compensation commitment' automatically generated by AI cannot be regarded as an expression of intent by the service provider
案涉生成式人工智能属于服务，而非产品，不应适用无过错责任原则: Generative artificial intelligence involved in the case constitutes a service rather than a product, and should not be subject to the principle of strict liability
杭州互联网法院认为，生成式人工智能技术服务提供者应对法律禁止的有毒、有害、违法信: The Hangzhou Internet Court holds that providers of generative artificial intelligence technology services should bear strict review obligations for toxic, harmful, and illegal information prohibited by law, while other general inaccuracies are not explicitly stipulated in current legal norms
同时，某科技公司已经在显著位置呈现AI生成内容功能局限的提醒标识，尽到了提示说明: Meanwhile, a certain technology company has already prominently displayed reminder notices of the functional limitations of AI-generated content, fulfilling its obligation to provide notification and explanation, and therefore bears no fault.
【专家点评】清华大学法学院教授程啸表示，这是我国目前第一起因生成式人工智能模型幻: 【Expert Commentary】Professor Cheng Xiao from the Law School of Tsinghua University stated that this is currently the first infringement dispute in China caused by hallucinations in generative artificial intelligence models, and the core disputed issues involved in the case are also issues that are receiving high attention and discussion in both domestic and international academic and practical circles.
审理本案的杭州互联网法院在充分权衡民事权益保护与鼓励促进人工智能技术发展基础上，: In adjudicating this case, the Hangzhou Internet Court, having fully balanced the protection of civil rights and interests with the encouragement and promotion of artificial intelligence technology development, has lawfully rendered a ruling on the aforementioned disputed issues, which holds extremely important theoretical significance and practical value
